sloka: अहं ते हृदयं राम जिह्वा देवी सरस्वती ।देवा गात्रेषु रोमाणि निर्मिता ब्रह्मणः प्रभो ।। ६.१२०.२५ ।।
transliteration: ahaṁ te hṛdayaṁ rāma jihvā devī sarasvatī ।devā gātreṣu romāṇi nirmitā brahmaṇaḥ prabho ।। 6.120.25 ।।

translations.english: "When you close your eyelids, it becomes night and when you open it becomes day. Your perfection in action are the Vedas. Without you, there is nothing."
